battle.name: 漢中之戰
battle.theater: 秦嶺漢中與隴西南仇池
battle.brief: 元嘉十年（433年），北魏太武帝拓跋燾西征：赫連夏主赫連定出長安而西走隴西，為吐谷渾所擒送平城，關中遂定；仇池氐人楊氏在漢中與隴右的地盤自此被魏軍直接威脅。戰役在秦嶺谷道與隴右水草之間拉鋸。卡面的埃及月牙劍並未上陣，它代表單刃外彎的砍刀譜系；而谷道狹窄，長槊與強弩才是主力。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 漢中之戰是北魏太武帝拓跋燾在四三三年對關中、隴右與漢中一線發動的西征戰役。正史並無以此為名的單獨戰役條目，戰名係後人依戰場所在地所加，其事則散見於《魏書》《宋書》與《資治通鑑》的記載。交戰方一為北魏：以平城為都的拓跋鮮卑政權，太武帝親率中軍出代北，麾下有南軍、北軍的騎兵與隨軍屯田兵，行軍序列按部落與州郡分番，抵關中後設行臺、置雍州，以降附之眾編軍。二為赫連夏：匈奴鐵弗部所建，都長安，主赫連定，統萬城既失，只餘關中殘部與隴右散兵。三為吐谷渾：吐谷渾部控青海與枹罕一帶，可汗慕利乾以騎兵截夏主西走之路，擒之送魏，藉此向北魏靠攏。四為仇池後仇池楊氏：氐人政權，據武都、漢中、隴右，武都王楊難當同時受北魏與劉宋封號，靠兩面周旋維持脆弱的自主。五為劉宋：元嘉十年在邊境施加牽制，並以名分羈縻，扶植仇池王子楊保宗居漢中一帶。雙方皆無正式宣戰，戰事實為北魏把秦嶺南北這條縱向通道收編的一場軍事接管。
countriesEn: The War of Hanzhong was a western campaign launched by the Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei, Tuoba Tao, in 433 against the line of Guanzhong, Longyou and Hanzhong. The official histories contain no single entry under this name; the title was given later on the basis of the ground on which the fighting took place, and the events themselves are scattered across the Wei Shu, the Song Shu and the Zizhi Tongjian. The first party was Northern Wei itself: a Tuoba Xianbei state with its capital at Pingcheng, whose Emperor Taiwu led the central host out of the Dai region in person, with the cavalry of the Southern and Northern Armies and the soldiers of the military colonies that marched with the army; the marching order was organised into turns by tribe and by commandery, and once the army reached Guanzhong an administrative office was set up, a Yongzhou commandery was created, and the surrendered population was enrolled into the host. The second party was the Hulao state of Xia, founded by the Jiebei Xiongnu, with its capital at Chang'an and its ruler Helian Ding; with Tongwan city already lost, it held nothing but the rump of its Guanzhong forces and scattered men in Longyou. The third was the Tuyuhun, a people holding the region around Qinghai and Qutan, whose khan Muliqian cut off the western road of the Xia ruler with his cavalry, sent the prisoner to Wei, and thereby drew close to the Wei court. The fourth was the later state of Chouchi of the Yang clan of the Di people, holding Wudu, Hanzhong and Longyou, whose Wudu king Yang Nandang accepted titles from both Northern Wei and the southern Song court and kept a fragile independence by playing the two sides against each other. The fifth was the Liu Song court, which in the tenth year of the Yuanjia reign applied pressure along the frontier and used investiture as a leash, backing the Chouchi prince Yang Baozong in the Hanzhong area. Neither side issued a formal declaration of war; the war was in substance a military takeover by which Northern Wei absorbed this north-south artery through the Qinling range.
people: 北魏方面，太武帝拓跋燾是全場主導者。他自四二九年平北燕、四三○年滅西秦之後，把兵鋒轉向西南，四三三年率大軍出雲中，經河套與關中道南下，親入長安，接管大夏的宮府與戶口，隨即在關中置雍州、括戶編民；他在隴右與漢中一線的部署，由尚書、將軍與鎮戍將領分頭執行，其意志透過行臺傳達，而非親臨每一處城邑。赫連夏主赫連定是失敗的一方：統萬城陷後奔長安，兵無鬥誌，再西走隴西上邽，終被吐谷渾可汗慕利乾的騎兵截住，連同左右與宮人被送抵平城，四三三年在平城被處死，夏國至此斷絕。吐谷渾的慕利乾在此役扮演關鍵角色：他沒有收留赫連定，反而將其縛送北魏，以換取魏廷的封賞與互市，同時為部眾取得關中與涼州的掠取機會。仇池方面，武都王楊難當是關鍵人物：他在楊保宗出走北魏之後接掌仇池，漢中、武都與隴右的氐人部眾及漢地城邑皆在其羈縻之下；北魏平夏之後，壓力全部轉到他身上，他不得不在北魏與劉宋之間周旋。劉宋一方以楊保宗為棋子：這位仇池王子先降北魏而得封武都王，其後奔宋，被授以安西將軍與漢中方面的職任，成為宋插在漢中的一枚釘子。關中與隴右的地方豪右、氐羌部眾多望風而降，被編為行軍與屯田的人力，這批被收編的舊夏部眾，是北魏後來經營關中最重要的兵源。
peopleEn: On the Northern Wei side, the Emperor Taiwu, Tuoba Tao, was the director of the whole operation. After the reduction of Northern Yan in 429 and the destruction of Western Qin in 430 he turned his armies to the southwest, and in 433 he led the great host out of Yungu, down through the Hetao and the Guanzhong road, entered Chang'an in person, took over the palace, the treasury and the registers of the Xia state, and then created Yongzhou in Guanzhong and sorted the population into the registers. His dispositions in Longyou and on the Hanzhong line were executed by ministers, generals and commanders of the garrisons separately; his will reached them through the travelling administrative office rather than by his own presence at every walled town. Helian Ding, ruler of the Xia, was the defeated party. After the fall of Tongwan city he fled to Chang'an with neither heart nor fighting spirit, then went west to Shanggui in Longyou, was finally intercepted by the cavalry of the Tuyuhun khan Muliqian, and was sent with his attendants and his household to Pingcheng, where he was put to death in 433; the Xia state came to an end with him. Muliqian of the Tuyuhun played the pivotal part in this campaign: he did not shelter Helian Ding but bound him and sent him to Northern Wei, in exchange for investiture and trade from the Wei court, while at the same time winning for his own people the chance to plunder Guanzhong and Liangzhou. On the Chouchi side the key figure was Yang Nandang, king of Wudu. After Yang Baozong fled to Northern Wei he took over Chouchi, and the Di tribal groups and the Han towns of Hanzhong, Wudu and Longyou all remained under his control; once Wei had settled the Xia business, the whole weight of that pressure fell on him, and he had to turn and turn between Wei and Song. On the Song side the pawn was Yang Baozong, the prince of Chouchi, who first surrendered to Northern Wei and was made king of Wudu, then fled to the Song court and was granted the title of General of the Western Regions together with offices in the Hanzhong area, becoming a nail driven into Hanzhong for the Song. In Guanzhong and Longyou the local great families and the Di and Qiang groups surrendered in large numbers when the armies drew near, and were enrolled as manpower for the host and for the colonies; these absorbed remnants of the old Xia troops became the most important source of soldiers for the way Northern Wei later governed Guanzhong.
kits: 本役的實際裝備，以騎兵刀槊、盾弩與攻城器械三者為核心。卡面所繪的埃及月牙劍是外彎的單刃短劍，砍下去不必拔出，屬於單刃外弧砍刀這一工藝譜系最早的一形態；它在四三三年並不存在於關中戰場，但它所代表的武器邏輯在中國有明確的對應物：漢代以來即已入軍的環首刀，單刃、微弧、可劈可勾，北方邊軍的戰士腰間佩刀、馬上持槊，短兵相接時以刀作最後一擊，而槊與矛才是正面拒馬的主力。北魏的披裝以鐵札甲為主，披膊與護臂相連，頭戴兜鍪；其精銳為人馬皆備的甲騎，即所謂具裝，源於鮮卑騎射與中原冶鐵的結合，配角筋木弓與長桿槊，衝鋒時以槊破陣、箭雨壓制，脫離時以馬速取回。步兵以大楯列陣，內操長槊，兩翼設蹶張弩與強弩射手，近距以刀盾應戰。攻城一端，北魏備有撞車、雲梯、巢車、飛橋、積薪，並能掘地道、絕其汲道；攻統萬城時已知以掛鉤攀城、用火焚燒樓櫓、截斷城中供水。守方的赫連夏在統萬城曾以鐵門、飛梯、撞車與火罐應戰；漢中與隴右的守軍則倚仗谿谷、棧道與塹壘，用壘石塞住谷口、以弩矢封住棧道，使騎兵無處展開。運輸與補給靠牛車與馭手，沿渭水、涇水與隴右屯田線就地取糧，並在關中與隴右設屯，供給遠征的兵員。
kitsEn: The real weight of equipment in this campaign lay in three things: the sabres and lances of the cavalry, the shields and crossbows of the foot, and the siege train. The Egyptian khopesh on the card is a short single-edged sword with an outward curve, which does not need to be pulled back out after a cut, and it belongs to the earliest form of a craft lineage of single-edged outward-curving chopping blades. It was of course not present on a battlefield in Guanzhong in 433, but the weapon logic it represents has a clear counterpart in China: the ring-pommel sabre, in military service since the Han, single-edged, slightly curved, able to chop and to hook, worn at the belt by the soldiers of the northern frontier and carried in company with the lance on horseback, the sabre being the last stroke in close combat while the lance and the spear did the work of holding the line. Northern Wei armour was based on iron lamellae, with shoulder and arm defences joined together and a helmet over the head; its elite was the armoured cavalry, the so-called fully equipped horse, born of Xianbei mounted archery combined with Chinese ironworking, using composite bows of horn and sinew and long-shafted lances, breaking the line with the lance and pressing with a shower of arrows, and breaking contact with the speed of the horse. The foot formed up behind large shields, wielded long spears within, and had drawn crossbows and powerful crossbowmen on both flanks, with sabre and shield work at close quarters. On the siege side Northern Wei brought battering rams, scaling ladders, siege towers, bridging gangways and brushwood faggots, and knew how to drive tunnels and cut off the wells; against Tongwan city it is recorded that they climbed with hooked poles, burned the wall galleries with fire, and cut the water supply of the town. On the defensive side the Xia at Tongwan answered with iron-faced gates, scaling ladders of their own, battering rams and fire jars; in Hanzhong and Longyou the garrisons relied on the ravines, the plank roads and the entrenchments, blocking the mouths of the valleys with piled stone and sealing the plank roads with crossbow bolts so that cavalry had no room to deploy. Transport and supply rested on ox carts and their drivers, drawing grain on the spot along the Wei and Jing rivers and along the line of military colonies in Longyou, with new colonies established in Guanzhong and Longyou to feed the marching army.
tactics: 北魏的戰法是「以騎制騎、以步結陣、以械破城」三者並行。大軍沿河套南下之後，不在秦嶺谷道內展開大量騎兵——谷道寬處不過數里，馬兵列陣毫無縱深——主力徒步推進，先以盾楯結陣封住谷口，把敵軍逼入狹窄地形，再以弩手在後列射，槊兵在陣前應敵，騎兵退到兩側山梁與高地，專司警戒、追擊與斷糧。前鋒與別部則沿涇水、渭水兩條河谷平行推進，一路取城置吏，一路斷赫連夏與仇池之間的聯絡；大軍出隴西時，別遣騎兵越嶺西馳，徑取仇池控制的武都與漢中，使夏主與氐人政權首尾不能相顧。攻城次序是先絕水、再絕糧，然後填壕、附城、壓櫓，最後以撞車與雲梯同時壓上一處城門；對統萬城那樣城防堅固的都城，則採圍而不急攻，斷水、斷糧、瓦解守軍士氣後再行強取。赫連夏的應對是放棄長安向西退走，意圖利用隴右的縱深與吐谷渾的外交周旋；仇池楊氏則以閉城固守、扼守谷口棧道為主，並在魏宋之間兩面下注。吐谷渾的介入是一記側翼包抄：它沒有正面參戰，而是切斷夏主西走的道路，藉此把北魏的注意力引向涼州與青海一線。
tacticsEn: The method of Northern Wei was three things at once: cavalry against cavalry, foot closed into a braced formation, and machines against walls. After the march south along the Hetao the army did not try to deploy large bodies of horse inside the Qinling valleys, for at their widest these gorges were only a few li across and mounted formations had no depth there; the main body advanced on foot, first shutting the mouth of the valley with a wall of shields so as to force the enemy into the narrow ground, then shooting from the drawn crossbows in the rear, the spearmen meeting the attack at the front of the line, while the cavalry withdrew to the ridges and heights on either flank for scouting, pursuit and cutting of supplies. The vanguard and the detached columns moved in parallel along the valleys of the Jing and the Wei, taking towns and installing officials on one side of the road and severing the link between Helian Xia and Chouchi on the other; when the main body pushed out into Longyou, separate cavalry was sent over the ridges to the west to strike straight at Wudu and Hanzhong under Chouchi control, so that the Xia ruler and the Di polity could not support one another. The order of a siege was to cut the water first, then the grain, then fill the ditches, build up against the walls, work the ladders, and finally press a single gate with rams and scaling ladders at the same moment; against a strongly defended capital such as Tongwan they chose to encircle rather than rush, and only attempted the storm after the water, the grain and the morale of the garrison had been broken. The Xia answer was to abandon Chang'an and fall back westward, hoping to use the depth of Longyou and the diplomatic room offered by the Tuyuhun. The Yang regime of Chouchi relied on holding its cities, on choking the mouths of the valleys and the plank roads, and on playing both Wei and Song. The Tuyuhun intervention was a flank envelopment: it did not join the battle in the open but cut the road along which the Xia ruler fled west, thereby drawing the attention of Northern Wei toward Liangzhou and the Qinghai side.
data: 時間線索方面：四三三年是劉宋元嘉十年、北魏泰始元年同年改元的年份；大夏的崩解橫跨數年——四二七年魏軍夜襲統萬城，四二八年夏主赫連昌在安定郡被俘，四三○年赫連定擊滅西秦，四三一年赫連定為吐谷渾所擒，四三二年送抵平城，四三三年在平城被處死，關中與隴右的接管亦在同一段時間內完成。距離方面，平城（今山西大同）至長安（今陝西西安）直線約九百公里，至漢中南鄭約一千零五十公里；長安至南鄭沿褒谷道約二百五十公里，子午谷道稍長；長安至枹罕（今甘肅臨夏）約六百公里，說明魏軍西征是長距離轉進而非奔襲。兵力方面，《魏書》《宋書》均不載此役確切人數，一般視北魏出動的是主力大軍，騎兵以萬計，而赫連夏與仇池所部皆以守城與地方部眾為主，總數無從核實。月份方面，正史只見春秋的概略記載，一般認為大軍在夏初已抵長安外圍，夏主西走與被擒落在同年秋，具體月日諸史皆略。城池方面，統萬城為夯土築成，形如口袋，其供水依賴城東南二池，故截水之策有效；漢中則為陝南水鄉，稻麥可耕，由漢中至成都的棧道寬處不過數尺，騎兵無用。人力方面，北魏在關中括得降戶與降卒，用以充屯田與行軍，隴右與河套一線的屯田在四二○年代即已開闢，成為西征的糧源；河西的涼州此時仍在沮渠氏北涼手中，故魏軍西征並非沒有後顧之憂。
dataEn: On the chronology: 433 is the tenth year of the Yuanjia reign of the Liu Song and the first year of the Taishi reign of Northern Wei, both courts changing era names in the same year. The dissolution of the Xia state ran across several years: in 427 the Wei army attacked Tongwan city by night; in 428 the Xia ruler Helian Chang was captured in the Anding commandery; in 430 Helian Ding destroyed Western Qin; in 431 he was taken by the Tuyuhun; in 432 he was brought to Pingcheng; in 433 he was put to death there, and the takeover of Guanzhong and Longyou was completed within the same span. On distances: the straight line from Pingcheng, modern Datong in Shanxi, to Chang'an, modern Xianyang in Shaanxi, is about 900 kilometres, and to Nanzheng in Hanzhong about 1,050 kilometres; from Chang'an to Nanzheng along the Bao valley road is about 250 kilometres, and the Ziyu valley road is somewhat longer; from Chang'an to Qutan, modern Linxia in Gansu, is about 600 kilometres, which shows that the western expedition of Wei was a long turning movement rather than a rush. On strength: neither the Wei Shu nor the Song Shu records exact numbers for this campaign. It is generally taken that Northern Wei put its main host into the field, with cavalry in the thousands, while the troops of Helian Xia and of Chouchi consisted chiefly of garrison troops and local tribal groups whose total cannot be verified. On the months: the histories give only a rough spring and autumn, and it is generally held that the main force stood outside Chang'an by early summer, with the flight west of the Xia ruler and his capture falling in the autumn of the same year; the exact days are given nowhere. On the towns: Tongwan was rammed earth built and shaped like a bag, and its water came from two ponds to the southeast of the city, which is why cutting the water worked; Hanzhong was a watered region south of the Qinling where rice and wheat were grown, and the plank road from Hanzhong to Chengdu was in places only a few feet wide, useless to horses. On manpower: Northern Wei sorted out surrendered households and surrendered soldiers in Guanzhong and used them to fill the colonies and the host, and the colonies in Longyou and along the Hetao had been opened as early as the 420s, becoming the grain source of the expedition; the Liangzhou of Liangzhou in Hexi was still held by the Juqu regime of Northern Liang at this time, so the western march was not without concerns to its rear.
cause: 打這場仗有五層原因。第一是北魏統一的收官：四二九年北燕覆滅、四三○年西秦被平，北方剩下的割據只剩關中的赫連夏與隴右的仇池楊氏，兩者南北相望，漢中正卡在它們之間的連繫上，不取漢中，夏與仇池便能互相呼應。第二是赫連夏的困局：統萬城失守之後，夏只剩長安一城，糧秣仰賴關中屯田，兵心已散；赫連定西走隴右，本意是投奔吐谷渾或聯絡仇池，以秦嶺谷道為軸重組防線。第三是仇池的處境：楊難當同時受魏宋封爵，靠兩面周旋維持自主，而北魏在關中得手之後，便可把全線壓力轉向漢中與武都，不必再分心。第四是吐谷渾的算盤：它不願大夏在隴右復辟，寧可把赫連定縛送平城，換取北魏的封賞與互市，同時保住青海與涼州的安全。第五是地理與補給的盤算：關中土地肥沃、隴右水草可屯，遠征兵員就近取糧；而涼州仍在沮渠氏手中，河套與河西都可能被趁虛，所以這一仗必須速戰速決，不能拖成持久。
causeEn: There were five layers of reason behind the war. First, the closing of Wei's unification: with Northern Yan destroyed in 429 and Western Qin levelled in 430, the only independent polities left in the north were the Xia of Guanzhong and the Chouchi Yang regime of Longyou, and they looked at each other across the north, with Hanzhong lying on the line between them; without Hanzhong, Xia and Chouchi could still call to one another. Second, the Xia was in a desperate position: after the loss of Tongwan it held nothing but the city of Chang'an, drew its grain from the colonies of Guanzhong, and had lost the heart of its soldiers; Helian Ding's flight west into Longyou was meant either to throw himself on the Tuyuhun or to join hands with Chouchi and rebuild a line along the gorges of the Qinling. Third, the position of Chouchi: Yang Nandang held titles from both Wei and Song and kept his independence by turning between them, and once Wei had its hands free in Guanzhong it could turn the whole weight of its pressure on Hanzhong and Wudu without dividing its attention. Fourth, the Tuyuhun's arithmetic: it did not want a restored Xia on its doorstep in Longyou, and preferred to bind Helian Ding and send him to Pingcheng in exchange for investiture and trade from Wei, while keeping the security of Qinghai and Liangzhou intact. Fifth, geography and supply: the fields of Guanzhong were rich and the water and grass of Longyou could be put under cultivation, so a distant army could draw its grain on the spot; and since Liangzhou was still in the hands of the Juqu house, both the Hetao and Hexi might be taken advantage of, so the war had to be fought quickly and could not be allowed to drag on.
impact: 此役的直接結果，是赫連夏在關中最後的掙扎結束，赫連定被斬於平城，大夏政權斷絕。北魏取得關中，於長安置雍州，括取降戶與降卒編為屯田與行軍，關中自此由割據政權的都城變成北魏的西面軍鎮與糧源基地；北魏的疆界第一次伸到秦嶺，與南朝劉宋在漢中、沔水一線直接接壤，雙方的邊界從此只剩一道狹窄的谷道與幾座山城，這種接觸在往後兩百年間不斷釀成摩擦與出兵。對仇池楊氏而言，漢中與武都的後路被切斷，最終在四四三年為北魏所滅，北魏自北方打通了通往蜀地的門戶，蜀地從此不再是與北朝毫無瓜葛的邊外之地。吐谷渾因為縛送赫連定而得到北魏的封號與互市便利，青海道與涼州的往來更為密切，北魏與西域的交通線也從此連成一條。制度與文化上，赫連夏創立的佛國傳統在關中終結，北魏的佛化則在平城與洛陽接續展開；關中胡漢共居的城邑格局在戰後被重新編排，遷入的降人與編戶使北魏在南方邊境第一次擁有一支可以就地補給的常備兵。
impactEn: The immediate result of the campaign was that the last stand of Helian Xia in Guanzhong came to an end; Helian Ding was beheaded at Pingcheng and the Xia polity was cut off. Northern Wei took Guanzhong, established Yongzhou at Chang'an, sorted out the surrendered households and the surrendered soldiers and enrolled them in the colonies and the host, and Guanzhong changed in a single stroke from the capital of a separatist state into the western military town and grain base of the Wei state. Wei's frontier reached the Qinling for the first time and came into direct contact with the southern Song court along the Hanzhong and Mian river line; from then on the border between them was no more than a narrow gorge and a handful of mountain towns, and that contact produced friction and campaigns again and again over the next two centuries. For the Yang regime of Chouchi, the rear route through Hanzhong and Wudu was cut, and the regime was finally destroyed by Northern Wei in 443; from the north Wei had opened a door onto the Sichuan basin, and Sichuan was no longer a country beyond the pale of the northern court. Because it had sent Helian Ding bound to the capital, the Tuyuhun received investiture and easier trade from Wei, the exchanges along the Qinghai road and through Liangzhou grew closer, and the line of communication between Wei and the states of the Western Regions was joined into one. In institutional and cultural terms, the Buddhist kingdom that Helian Xia had created came to an end in Guanzhong, while the Buddhist transformation of the Wei court continued at Pingcheng and then at Luoyang; the pattern of towns in which Chinese and non-Chinese families lived together was rearranged after the war, and the migrants and enrolled households gave Wei, for the first time on its southern frontier, a standing army that could be supplied on the spot.
result: 結果是赫連定出長安而西走隴西，被吐谷渾可汗慕利乾的騎兵截住，連同左右送抵平城，四三三年在平城被處死，赫連夏滅亡，關中入魏。北軍隨即接管長安及其四郊，設行臺、置雍州，收括降戶，遷主力還鎮長安與涼州一線，而仇池楊氏在漢中與隴右的地盤被直接接管，楊難當降魏，仍被授以武都王與朝廷官職，仇池政權延續到四四三年才被正式消滅。軍事的勝負並不在任何一場野戰：夏人退得太快，關中與隴右的城邑在魏軍到來之前多數望風而降，赫連定的西走反而把最後的兵力與人望送到吐谷渾手裡；魏軍真正的戰果是速度——長距離轉進之後，兵鋒未疲而敵已散。從更長的視角看，四三三年這場戰爭標誌著北魏在北方整合的關鍵一步：關中入魏，漢中在望，而河西的沮渠氏北涼又六年後滅亡，北方的割據至此只剩江南劉宋一處，兩國以秦嶺為界對峙的格局由此固定下來。兵器一端也留下痕跡：這條谷道從此成為北魏與南朝反覆爭奪的通道，沿線的刀、矛、弩與馬具，正是後來魏宋、魏齊百年間反覆演繹的戰爭物質。
resultEn: The result was that Helian Ding left Chang'an and went west into Longyou, was intercepted by the cavalry of the Tuyuhun khan Muliqian, was brought with his attendants to Pingcheng, and was put to death there in 433; the Xia state was destroyed and Guanzhong passed to Wei. The northern army then took over Chang'an and its outskirts, set up a travelling administrative office, established Yongzhou, sorted out the surrendered households, and moved its main body back to the line of Chang'an and Liangzhou, while the Chouchi Yang lands in Hanzhong and Longyou were taken over directly; Yang Nandang surrendered to Wei and was still granted the title of king of Wudu together with offices at the Wei court, and the Chouchi polity survived only until 443 before being formally extinguished. The decision was not settled by any single field battle: the Xia withdrew too fast, most of the towns of Guanzhong and Longyou surrendered before the Wei army arrived, and the flight west of Helian Ding handed the last of his soldiers and his prestige over to the Tuyuhun. The real achievement of the Wei army was speed, for after a long turning movement the edge of their weapons was still fresh when the enemy had already scattered. Seen from further back, the war of 433 marked the decisive step in the integration of the north by Northern Wei: Guanzhong came under Wei, Hanzhong came into view, and the Juqu regime of Northern Liang in Hexi was destroyed six years later, leaving only the Song court in the south as an independent power; the pattern of two states facing each other across the Qinling was fixed from that point on. In terms of weapons, the gorge also left a trace: this route became the corridor that Northern Wei and the southern courts fought over again and again, and the sabres, spears, crossbows and harness that moved along it were the war material of the contests played out between Wei and Song, and between Wei and Qi, over the following century.
